title: The Lost Key
text:
Ali has a blue bag. Today he cannot find his house key. He looks in his bag and in his pockets. The key is not there.

Ali sits on the steps and thinks. Then he remembers his morning walk. He goes back to the park and finds the key under a bench. Ali smiles and goes home.

questions.text: Where does Ali find the key?
options: Under a bench in the park

questions.text: How does Ali feel at the end of the story?
Why did Ali go back to the park?

vocabulary.definition: thinks again about something from the past
makes a happy face with the mouth
a long seat for more than one person, often outside

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin mavi bir çantası var. Bugün ev anahtarını bulamıyor. Çantasına ve cebine bakıyor. Anahtar orada değil.
Ali basamaklarda oturur ve düşünür. Sonra sabah yürüyüşünü hatırlar. Parka geri döner ve anahtarı bir bankın altında bulur. Ali gülümser ve eve gider.
